'父母爻' as a six-kin label in a 大六壬 argument is also attested in online《大六壬探原》transcript; don't assume exclusively 六爻卦位. 2026-11-22 user's current oral methodological interpretation: condensed classical maxims in p59–68 are pedagogical memory aids and interpretive entry points rather than universally correct unqualified truths. Special cases may require careful context analysis, but this reader interpretation of mnemonic purpose is not a historically documented author motive or evidence of predictive efficacy. 2026-11-22 independent physical re-read and finite proof: p67 '日辰上各见德神' is unreachable under the book's 日德、支德 (子见巳、丑见午... +5) and 十干寄宫 table. It does not validate the positive auspicious judgement or transfer to divergent system tables. 2026-11-24 Forward correction p60 diagram/independent rule calculation show 酉乘太常, not text 贵人. Treat as source conflict, not verified example; p59 potential circular dependence between whole-chart 气势 and local 生/败. p67 prior structural proof simplified to 0 or +4 vs +5. 2026-11-24 p60与p64–65同癸巳d8四课三传，月将和占时不同；p64乙卯例寄宫辰被卯克而乙木本身与卯比和，明确分离参照。

entries.title: 卷二第三节p69–76：类神与发用重合、初中末角色、三传多组取象及冲突取舍边界
entries.required_evidence: Eight user-owned modern printed pp69–76; p69 explicitly says 类神 may not enter transmissions nor necessarily be at initial; nine dimensions of 發用 can be selectively composed; p70–74 treats 初中末 as stage, intermediary and ending plus occupation-specific human roles; p75–76 contain 合局/进退/回环/传生传克/俱空 and severe result sayings. Book's order is clear, but rules for selecting/weighting competing structural signs, choosing from nine dimensions, when to use phase vs person interpretation, and independent predictive evidence remain underdetermined. 2026-11-22 user's oral co-reading of p69: 发用=初传; regards 类之所在/课心所在 as the preceding claim that class god is central; objects to shorthand ‘类神出现在发用’ because 类神 names a conceptual category while an actual resolved class-god indicator (支神/天将等, according to rule) may coincide with initial transmission. Nine dimensions are an available feature list, not mandatory every time; author selects what appears salient and relevant to question type. No explicit criterion defining 'salient enough' is supplied in visible p69. 2026-11-22 joint p69–71: user emphasizes 亥驿马 in travel, 干传支 as position-transition with Guide quote, standardized name 初传 with 用/用神/发传/发端门 as contextual aliases, analogical comparison to 梅花易数主互变 initial/middle/final, the author's first-hand claim that 发用 or 干上 better predicts visitor's 来意 than 正时, 旺相速休囚缓 conditional when 类神临发用, and special subject-specific roles of 初传. Needs keep older p69 calculation mismatch open, not universalize associations or claim independent predictive evidence. 2026-11-22 user p73–74 discussion: 中传／末传各可能为类神所在并共用p69初传的九维分析；中传可作过程、人、物中段或阻隔，末传归计门可作最终结果、末端，在行人占中有行人足与足空归至的传统特例。必须区分普遍阶段框架和占事特定义；用户只是概念讨论，未验证古例。 2026-11-22 user p74–75 co-reading: suggested first/third lesson plus transmissions for class-god lookup is best treated as heuristic, not universal exclusivity; 三传互化 likely reflects directional event development but the text provides examples 財→鬼 vs 鬼→子孙 rather than comprehensive formal constraints. ‘前引后从’ requires clarifying exact reference of relative 前后; ‘回环格’ printed as 三传不离四课, linked with outcome formation regardless of positive/negative; 三传三合 and 三传合局 introduced separately, combined 五行 is not the raw native five element of each transmission. 2026-11-22 user explicitly corrected study process: assistant must independently read and understand every printed paragraph, especially all conditional '凡/若/但/则' judgments, regardless of what user chooses to mention. Earlier p69-76 summary overly selective for p71-73 detailed maxims. Fresh direct audit of private page photos now indexed as SESSION-0048. A key condition is p72: a class of 六亲 must actually appear in 四课 before inferring that 发用克去 that class; absence is not defeat. 2026-11-22 assistant-only SESSION-0050: p76递生/递克须分别检查三传箭头及是否终结于日干；线上《六壬粹言》卷三具申亥寅/戌午寅两向递生例。线上《壬归》卷一透关段明确一传外透后仍须看该传相对日干的六亲；《金针》第三方在线文字在透关处截断，纸本不因此被判缺字。两旬空加一传乘天空仅为传统组合定义，非三支全部旬空。未验证版本、完整起课或预测准确率。 2026-11-22 SESSION-0050 addendum: independently reconstructed 壬归甲子日干上丑→甲寄寅, shifted heaven upper 丑/子/亥/戌 at 寅/丑/子/亥; lessons 丑甲、子丑、亥子、戌亥, two 下贼上 candidate 丑/子; 比用甲阳日取子, then 子亥戌. Structural checks agree with online example. Yet 透关'日辰之中' spatial containment not formally defined, so still OPEN. 2026-11-24 Direct reinspection p76 confirms physical 透关 sentence itself ends abruptly, not just online transcript. p75 even-offset same-parity and d4/8 trine dependencies for ordinary sequential transmissions. p73 求脱忧 opposite formulations require context; p75 objective-dependent benefit preserved. Repeated branch positions may all be void; distinguish from three distinct void branches. 2026-11-24 SESSION-0052 p71初传出现课位与实际下贼上/上克下课源不同：418个基础输入中60个初传支跨干支课；乙丑d3未仅第一课为下贼来源，甲子d2辰有双来源。p74优先支集合114完全覆盖、304不全，非类神遗漏率。p75全财/全鬼四支列举及合局/本五行边界待校。 2026-11-24 SESSION-0053: ordinary distinct recursive transmissions can include two adjacent xunkong branches only at d=1/11; among 418 previously defined unique zei-ke/bi-yong inputs 19 have two void branches, two have a day/night configuration in which remaining branch carries 天空 (戊申d11夜 and 壬戌d1昼).
